summary: Iteration 48 - Comprehensive testing of ACTOOS PRO Supabase migration. Login works, Client CRUD works, but several critical Supabase issues remain: 1) Interventions/Planning have relationship ambiguity error (PGRST201), 2) Techniciens query fails due to invalid enum value 'tech' (22P02), 3) SSE/Legacy API endpoints return 401 errors. Dashboard loads but shows 0 stats due to these errors.

critical.issue: PGRST201: Could not embed because more than one relationship was found for 'interventions' and 'users'. The query uses 'technicien:users(...)' but Supabase cannot determine which foreign key to use.
22P02: invalid input value for enum user_role: 'tech'. The role enum in Supabase doesn't include 'tech' value, only 'technicien' or other values.
22P02: invalid input syntax for type uuid: ''. Empty client_id being sent when creating intervention without selecting a client.
401 Unauthorized - SSE connection fails repeatedly. Legacy Railway API endpoints not working with Supabase auth.
401 Unauthorized - Plan usage endpoint fails. AxiosError in console.

minor.issue: Console warning: 'Could not fetch entreprise currency' - Non-blocking but indicates missing data

integration_issues.issue: Shows 'Aucune intervention trouvée' due to PGRST201 relationship ambiguity error
Shows empty list due to invalid enum value 'tech' in role filter
Shows empty calendar due to same PGRST201 error as interventions
All stats show 0 due to techniciens query failure and other errors

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Supabase interventions-users relationship ambiguity. In supabaseHooks.js and supabaseApi.js, change 'technicien:users(...)' to 'technicien:users!interventions_technicien_id_fkey(...)' to specify the exact foreign key
CRITICAL: Fix user_role enum in Supabase. Either add 'tech' to the enum or change all queries from .in('role', ['tech', 'technicien']) to .in('role', ['technicien'])
HIGH: Fix intervention creation form to handle empty client_id - either make client required or send null instead of empty string
MEDIUM: Disable or fix SSE connection - it's causing many 401 errors in console
MEDIUM: Fix legacy API endpoints or migrate them to Supabase Edge Functions
critical_code_review_comments: supabaseHooks.js line 248: Query 'technicien:users(...)' causes PGRST201 error - need to specify foreign key explicitly
supabaseHooks.js line 353: Query filters by role 'tech' which doesn't exist in Supabase enum - should use 'technicien' only
supabaseApi.js line 12: Same relationship ambiguity issue in interventionsApi.list()
supabaseApi.js line 402: usersApi.getTechniciens() uses .in('role', ['tech', 'technicien']) - 'tech' is invalid

success_rate.backend: 40% (Login works, Clients CRUD works, but Interventions/Techniciens/Planning fail)
success_rate.frontend: 70% (UI loads correctly, navigation works, but data operations partially fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login and Client CRUD work correctly. Main blockers are: 1) Supabase relationship ambiguity in interventions table (need to specify foreign key), 2) Invalid enum value 'tech' in user_role (should be 'technicien' only). These two issues block Interventions, Techniciens, Planning, and Dashboard stats.

login_enterprise.details: Login with contact@actoos.com works via Supabase Edge Function

dashboard.details: UI loads but all stats show 0 due to query errors

interventions_list.details: PGRST201 error - relationship ambiguity between interventions and users

interventions_create.details: Form loads but submission fails with uuid error for empty client_id

devis_list.details: Devis list loads (shows empty - no data)

factures_list.details: Factures list loads (shows empty - no data)

techniciens_list.details: 22P02 error - invalid enum value 'tech' for user_role

settings.details: Settings page loads and shows enterprise info correctly

root_cause_1.cause: The 'interventions' table has multiple foreign keys to 'users' table (likely technicien_id and created_by). When using 'technicien:users(...)' in the select, Supabase cannot determine which FK to use.

root_cause_2.cause: The Supabase user_role enum doesn't include 'tech' value. Frontend code filters by ['tech', 'technicien'] but only 'technicien' exists.
root_cause_2.solution: Either add 'tech' to the enum in Supabase, or change all frontend queries to use only 'technicien'

reproduction_steps: 2. Navigate to Interventions page - observe PGRST201 error in console
3. Navigate to Techniciens page - observe 22P02 error in console
4. Navigate to Planning page - observe same PGRST201 error
